'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Anderson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
